full_judgment: 4. The petitioner subsequently filed an application for issuance of supplementary rule stating that after issuance of the rule with an order of stay, the petitioner communicated the same to the Bank and came to know that the mortgaged property as mentioned in the schedule of the application i.e. District-Dhaka. Police Station-'Mohammadpur, Mouza-Brab, JL No.238, Khatian No.CS232, SA- 173.Dag No. CS and SA 701, Mutation Khatian No. 170/9, of land 25 decimals  (hereinafter referred to as the mortgaged property/the property) has already been sold by registered saf kabala deed NO.9193/2010 dated 28-10-2010 to respondent No. 11 in auction. The said sale deed has been executed without giving any information to the petitioner and no offer was made to the petitioner for purchasing the same at the auction price and, as such, the execution and registration of the Saf kabala deed No.9193/2010 dated 28-10-2010 for the property is liable to be declared to be without lawful authority.
